question: Under the same world identity and the same seed, does a per-agent evolved brain (evolved=true) change outcomes relative to the default shared BrainModel (evolved=false), and in which direction?
model_status: headless adapter verified; NOT a live-world experiment-ready claim

hypotheses.rationale: Treatment brains are randomly initialised and never selected (the adapter runs no evolution thread), and the actor head is a sigmoid, so gate outputs sit near 0.5 while ACTION_GATE_THRESHOLD is 0.5 and the legacy gates are pinned fully open at 1.0. Partially closing feed_intent should lower energy intake.
attack_intent closes in the same way feed_intent does, which relieves predation pressure on prey while also starving predators; the net sign is not predictable from the mechanism.
Reported for both arms as an implementation check, never as a treatment outcome. A paired difference past the materiality threshold is filed as a defect finding, not as evidence about brains.

seeds.rule: seed_k = 700001 + 1000*k for k in 0..11, fixed before any run
seeds.smoke_seed_exclusion_is_mechanical: 999983 is absent from both experimental manifests' seed lists, and run_manifest_seed returns RunStatus::Failed{SeedNotInManifest} for a seed the manifest does not declare, so the smoke seed cannot enter the experimental ensemble even by mistake.

duration.ladder_rule: The rung is chosen ONCE, from the smoke calibration, before any experimental seed runs. It may never be changed after an experimental seed has run.

thresholds.between_rule: detectable but below the preregistered materiality threshold; counts as NOT different enough

reporting.failed_runs: every failed run is reported with its seed and reason; none is dropped

cost.measured_subset_source: benchmark_report.json criterion medians on Intel Core i5-14600KF: step_regrowth_gated_strided 55.0 us + rebuild_spatial_grid_system@100 13.4 us + integrate_physics_system@100 0.49 us
cost.on_budget_exceeded: step down the preregistered duration ladder using the smoke calibration only, before any experimental seed runs; never lower N, and never change T after data exists

files.effects.json: the per-observable table named in reporting.per_observable_fields plus additional_derived
files.provenance.json: build commit, cargo/rustc versions, host, profile, start/end timestamps, control+treatment manifest fingerprints, law fingerprint, registry fingerprint, the observed WorldIdentity resource from each arm, seed list, smoke seed, duration rung used
files.summary.md: human-readable table plus the decision the rules below produce
files.smoke/: the calibration run's outputs, kept separate and never merged into the analysis

reproduction_command: cargo build --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --release --features desktop --example run_e2_brain_experiment; then execute src-tauri/target/release/examples/run_e2_brain_experiment.exe --ensemble --manifest-dir src-tauri/tests/fixtures/experiments_e2 --out artifacts/experiments/e2-evolved-brain-default

reproduction_command_correction.corrected_by: E2-B, before any smoke or experimental run
reproduction_command_correction.reason: TRANSPORT AND SAFETY ONLY. The owner's standing rule on this machine forbids launching the app or the full backend by any route, and `cargo run` is one of those routes; the rule is categorical rather than a judgement about what this particular example does. The corrected form builds the example and then executes the compiled headless binary directly, which is the same program by the same code path.
reproduction_command_correction.scientific_parameters_changed: none - the question, hypotheses, metrics, thresholds, seeds, N, smoke seed, duration ladder, sample period, failure handling and decision rule are untouched by this correction

smoke_command: cargo build --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --release --features desktop --example run_e2_brain_experiment; then execute src-tauri/target/release/examples/run_e2_brain_experiment.exe --smoke --manifest-dir src-tauri/tests/fixtures/experiments_e2 --out artifacts/experiments/e2-evolved-brain-default
blocking_preconditions: P1: core::live_experiment::build_live_world hard-codes BrainPolicy::default(), so no manifest can request evolved=true.
P2: core::live_experiment::genesis never inserts an AgentBrain, unlike the app genesis in core::simulation_loop, so the treatment arm has no brains even with the policy on.
P3: no runner binary exists for this experiment; the reproduction_command names one E2-B must add.

decision_rule.flip_default_to_evolved_true_only_if: H1 reaches materiality in the POSITIVE direction (treatment better) AND no harness-integrity finding is open AND cargo test --features desktop stays green AND EB-S03 allocs==0 still holds
decision_rule.keep_opt_in_if: H1 is null, or reaches materiality in the negative direction
decision_rule.insufficient_evidence_if: fewer than 10 complete pairs, or a blocking precondition was satisfied in a way that departs from this preregistration
decision_rule.additional_evidence_named_for_insufficie: a run in which evolutionary replacement actually operates, so selection has something to act on; the adapter today drains epoch statistics and never applies a replacement, so E2 measures brains that are never selected
decision_rule.defects_are_not_insufficiency: a real evolved-brain defect found during E2 is recorded and fixed as a defect; it may never be reported as insufficient evidence
